items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I knew him, you know, met him, but I was fortunate enough to get in on the ground floor with these the greats.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't do too much record listening, because I was one of the few fortunate ones to have been in person with these guys so much, so I sacrificed the record deals where probably other musicians would lend an ear. In later years, I've had to listen to records, because I didn't travel too much, you know, and I wanted to listen to some of the up coming guys, you know, that we've had. Now, I used to listen to a lot of Bird's things, because I didn't get a chance to see Byrd much. I knew him, you know, met him,…
fortunate enough to get in on the ground floor with these the greats.
